---
title: "Data & More"

---

Data plays a central role in Computational Social Science. Without reliable and well-documented data, empirical research is not possible.

To support your projects, we have compiled a list of relevant data sources for computational analyses. You are warmly encouraged to contribute additional datasets that you find useful. Sharing resources helps strengthen the research community and benefits everyone.

You can **access and contribute** to the complete list in the following document:

[Docs document](https://docs.numerique.gouv.fr/docs/e9d02d65-0de2-468d-8592-7d4f5365ae87/).
